description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Birchlore Rangers, adding {C}{C}.
Birchlore Rangers dies, triggering Yedora, returning Birchlore Rangers to the battlefield face down as a Forest land with no other types or abilities.
Activate Birchlore Rangers by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Birchlore Rangers's morph ability by paying {G}, turning it face up.
Repeat.
